title: Maths, Years 4 to 6
subject: maths
year_note: Written for the New Zealand Curriculum, Years 4 to 6 (Levels 2 to 3); the title says so.
source_note: Written for the New Zealand Curriculum, Years 4 to 6 (Levels 2 to 3), ages 8 to 11. Covers times facts, place value, fractions, decimals, percentages, rounding, measurement, angles, symmetry, timetables and graphs, probability, and negative numbers. Checked 2026-08-30.

questions.explanation: 6 groups of 7 make 42.
45 split into 9 equal groups gives 5 in each.

questions.prompt: In the number 4,826, what is the value of the digit 8?
questions.explanation: The 8 sits in the hundreds place, so it stands for 800.

questions.prompt: Which fraction shows exactly half?
questions.explanation: One half means one part out of two equal parts.

questions.prompt: What do we call an angle that is exactly 90 degrees?
questions.explanation: A right angle is exactly 90 degrees, like the corner of a square.

questions.prompt: Round 47 to the nearest 10.
questions.explanation: 47 is closer to 50 than to 40, so it rounds up to 50.

questions.prompt: How many centimetres are in 1 metre?
questions.explanation: A metre is made up of 100 centimetres.

questions.prompt: A shape has a line of symmetry if...?
choices: folding it in half along that line makes both sides match exactly
it has more than one colour
questions.explanation: A line of symmetry is a fold line where both halves match exactly.

questions.prompt: 0.5 is the same amount as which fraction?
questions.explanation: 0.5 means 5 tenths, which is the same as one half.

questions.prompt: What is 10 more than 356?
questions.explanation: Adding 10 changes the tens digit, so 356 becomes 366.

questions.prompt: What is 23 × 4?
questions.explanation: 20 × 4 is 80 and 3 × 4 is 12, and 80 plus 12 gives 92.
84 split into 7 equal groups gives 12 in each.

questions.prompt: In 7,309 what is the value of the digit 3?
questions.explanation: The 3 sits in the hundreds place, so it is worth 300.

questions.prompt: Which of these is the same amount as 3/4?
questions.explanation: Three quarters means 75 out of 100, which is 75%.

questions.prompt: What is 50% of 20?
questions.explanation: 50% means half, and half of 20 is 10.

questions.prompt: Round 683 to the nearest 100.
questions.explanation: 683 is closer to 700 than to 600, so it rounds up.

questions.prompt: A rectangle is 5 cm long and 3 cm wide. What is its perimeter?
questions.explanation: Perimeter is the distance all the way round: 5 + 3 + 5 + 3 makes 16 cm.

questions.prompt: A square has sides of 4 cm. What is its area?
questions.explanation: The area of a square is side times side, so 4 × 4 gives 16 square cm.

questions.prompt: How many grams are in 1 kilogram?
questions.explanation: A kilogram is made up of 1,000 grams.

questions.prompt: How many millilitres are in 1 litre?
questions.explanation: A litre holds 1,000 millilitres.

questions.prompt: Which angle is bigger than a right angle but smaller than a straight line?
questions.explanation: An obtuse angle measures somewhere between 90 and 180 degrees.

questions.prompt: A regular hexagon has how many lines of symmetry?
questions.explanation: A regular hexagon has six equal sides, so it has six lines of symmetry.

questions.prompt: If you roll a normal six-sided dice once, what is the chance of rolling a 4?
questions.explanation: There are six equally likely numbers on the dice, so each one has a 1 in 6 chance.

questions.prompt: What is 234 × 3?
questions.explanation: 200 × 3 is 600, 30 × 3 is 90, and 4 × 3 is 12. Added together that makes 702.
156 split into 4 equal groups gives 39 in each.

questions.prompt: Which fraction is equivalent to 2/3?
questions.explanation: Multiplying the top and bottom of 2/3 by 2 gives 4/6, which is the same amount split into more pieces.

questions.prompt: Write 0.6 as a fraction in its simplest form.
questions.explanation: 0.6 means 6 tenths, or 6/10. Dividing the top and bottom by 2 simplifies that to 3/5.

questions.prompt: What is 25% of 60?
questions.explanation: 25% is a quarter, and a quarter of 60 is 15.

questions.prompt: Round 3,847 to the nearest 1,000.
questions.explanation: 3,847 is closer to 4,000 than to 3,000, so it rounds up.

questions.prompt: A garden is 6 m long and 4 m wide. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area is length times width, so 6 × 4 gives 24 square metres.

questions.prompt: A path goes all the way round a rectangular field 30 m by 20 m. How far is that?
questions.explanation: Perimeter is 30 + 20 + 30 + 20, which adds up to 100 metres.

questions.prompt: Two angles sit on a straight line. One is 110 degrees. What is the other?
questions.explanation: Angles on a straight line always add up to 180 degrees, so 180 minus 110 leaves 70.

questions.prompt: How many centimetres are in 2.5 metres?
questions.explanation: Each metre is 100 cm, so 2.5 metres is 2.5 × 100, which is 250 cm.

questions.prompt: A bus timetable shows a bus leaving at 9:15 and taking 25 minutes to reach town. What time does it arrive?
questions.explanation: 9:15 plus 25 minutes lands on 9:40.

questions.prompt: A bag has 4 red balls and 6 blue balls. What is the chance of picking a red ball without looking?
questions.explanation: There are 10 balls in total and 4 are red, so the chance is 4 out of 10.

questions.prompt: What is 47 × 26?
questions.explanation: 47 × 20 is 940 and 47 × 6 is 282, and 940 plus 282 makes 1,222.
8 × 39 is 312, so 312 divided by 8 is 39.

questions.prompt: What is 3/4 of 24?
questions.explanation: A quarter of 24 is 6, and three quarters is three lots of 6, which is 18.

questions.prompt: A shop puts a $40 jacket up by 10%. What is the new price?
questions.explanation: 10% of $40 is $4, and adding that to $40 gives $44.

questions.prompt: Round 6.28 to one decimal place.
questions.explanation: Look at the second decimal place, which is 8. That rounds the first decimal place up from 2 to 3.

questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 8 cm and a height of 5 cm. What is its area?
questions.explanation: The area of a triangle is half the base times the height. Half of 8 × 5, which is half of 40, is 20 square cm.

questions.prompt: Four angles meet at a point. Three of them are 90, 90 and 100 degrees. What is the fourth?
questions.explanation: Angles all the way around a point add up to 360 degrees. 90 + 90 + 100 makes 280, and 360 minus 280 leaves 80.

questions.prompt: How many millimetres are in 3.5 metres?
questions.explanation: Each metre is 1,000 mm, so 3.5 metres is 3.5 × 1,000, which is 3,500 mm.

questions.prompt: On a cold morning the temperature is minus 2 degrees. By midday it has risen by 7 degrees. What is the midday temperature?
questions.explanation: Starting at minus 2 and going up 7 degrees lands on 5 degrees.

questions.prompt: A graph shows a line climbing steadily from left to right. What does that usually mean?
choices: The amount is increasing over time
The amount is staying the same
The amount is decreasing over time
There is no pattern at all
questions.explanation: A line sloping upward on a graph shows the value getting bigger as time goes on.

questions.prompt: Which of these lists is ordered from smallest to largest: -5, 2, -8, 0?
questions.explanation: On a number line, the further left a number sits, the smaller it is, so -8 comes before -5.

questions.prompt: A rectangle 12 cm by 8 cm has a smaller rectangle 4 cm by 3 cm cut out of one corner. What is the area left over?
questions.explanation: The whole rectangle is 96 square cm and the cut-out piece is 12 square cm, so 96 minus 12 leaves 84.

questions.prompt: A number is between 3,000 and 4,000. Rounded to the nearest 100 it becomes 3,500. Which of these could it be?
questions.explanation: Numbers from 3,450 up to 3,549 all round to 3,500, and 3,462 is the only one of these that falls in that range.

questions.prompt: A spinner is split into 8 equal sections numbered 1 to 8. What is the chance of spinning a number greater than 5?
questions.explanation: Three of the eight numbers, 6, 7 and 8, are greater than 5, so the chance is 3 out of 8.

questions.prompt: Which decimal, fraction and percentage all describe the same amount?
questions.explanation: 0.75 means 75 hundredths, which is the same amount as three quarters and as 75 percent.
